full_text_en:
Su Feng — Intentional Homicide Case

Defendant: Su Feng, alias Zhang Zhisheng, male, 29 years old, a native of Su County, Anhui Province. Formerly an employee of the Yicheng District Construction Company of Zaozhuang City, Shandong Province. Prior to arrest, resided in Xihe Village, Gaoluo Township, Yuanqu County, Shanxi Province. Arrested on October 12, 1984.

In 1977, defendant Su Feng began a romantic relationship with Wang ××, a female worker at the same company. Later, when Wang ×× proposed to end the relationship, Su Feng bore a grudge against her. At midnight on February 17, 1979, Su Feng broke the glass of the door to Wang ××'s room, unlatched the door, and forced his way inside. Wang ×× and her sister Wang Hongxia, who were sleeping, were awakened. Su Feng simultaneously demanded the return of gifts he had given Wang ×× during the relationship and grabbed a wooden club over one meter long from inside the room, striking Wang ×× violently on the head. Wang Hongxia, seeing this, ran into the courtyard and called for help. Su Feng pursued her with the club, striking her repeatedly on the head until she fell unconscious. At that time, Wang ×× also ran into the courtyard and screamed for help. Su Feng turned around and chased after Wang ××. Wang ×× fled back into the room and bolted the door. Su Feng forced the door open, entered, and again struck Wang ×× violently on the head and face, rendering her unconscious. Thereafter, Su Feng returned to the courtyard. Seeing that Wang Hongxia was still alive, he struck her several more times on the head, killing her, and then moved her body into the room. At that moment, Wang ×× regained consciousness and pleaded with Su Feng not to harm her further. Su Feng then carried her to the bed and fled the scene. Although Wang ×× was rescued and survived, she lost the sight in her left eye.

After committing the crime, defendant Su Feng fled to Xihe Village, Gaoluo Township, Yuanqu County, Shanxi Province, where he assumed the alias Zhang Zhisheng and falsely claimed to be a destitute orphan who had left Su County, Anhui Province to seek a livelihood, thereby gaining the trust of local farmers. He first worked as a temporary worker at a brick and tile kiln, and later as a designer and construction worker for a township construction team. During the Spring Festival of 1981, he married a local woman, Ji ××, and they later had one son and one daughter. In April 1983, Su Feng wrote to his parents to let them know he was still alive. In June 1983 and October 1984, Su Feng's parents visited Yuanqu County twice and urged him to surrender. Su Feng also felt that evading punishment could not last indefinitely. After intense internal struggle, he resolved to surrender and seek lenient treatment. Su Feng told his wife Ji ×× the full account of his crime, and Ji ×× supported his decision to surrender. On October 11, 1984, Su Feng accompanied his parents back to Zaozhuang City, Shandong Province, and surrendered himself to the public security authorities, truthfully confessing all the facts of the crime.

On November 12, 1984, Zaozhuang Intermediate People's Court of Shandong Province tried the case in accordance with the law. The court found that defendant Su Feng, because the victim Wang ×× had terminated their romantic relationship, premeditated murder, causing serious injury to Wang ×× and killing Wang Hongxia, thereby committing the crime of intentional homicide under Article 132 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. The circumstances and consequences of Su Feng's crime were particularly serious, and he should be severely punished according to law. However, after committing the crime, Su Feng surrendered upon the advice of his parents and with the support of his wife, showing repentance. In accordance with Article 63 of the Criminal Law, a lighter punishment could be imposed. On this basis, the court sentenced defendant Su Feng to life imprisonment for intentional homicide, with a lighter punishment, and also deprived him of political rights for life in accordance with Article 53, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. After the judgment was pronounced, Su Feng did not appeal.

At its 225th meeting on April 25, 1985, the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, in accordance with Article 11, paragraph 1 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the PRC, and while summarizing trial experience, found that the Zaozhuang Intermediate People's Court of Shandong Province had correctly applied the law in its judgment in this case, the sentence was appropriate, and the trial procedure was lawful, providing a reference for people's courts at all levels.
